seoDescription: Faiz Dzulfikar is a medical doctor in Yogyakarta with an interest in cardiology, public health, technology and design. A personal profile, and a work in progress.

hero.headline: A physician, a curious mind, and a perpetual work in progress.
hero.intro:
I'm Faiz, a medical doctor based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Depending on when you meet me, I might be talking about cardiovascular medicine, building a web application, dissecting a healthcare system, obsessing over a new piece of technology, or complaining about how difficult running is while voluntarily signing up for another race.

I have a habit of getting deeply interested in things. Sometimes a little too deeply. My interests tend to evolve, my browser tabs tend to multiply, and my list of things I want to learn never seems to get shorter.

items.label: Recurring problem
items.value: Too many interests, too little time
